label: User (Sync Gateway, Public API identity)
type: core Sync Gateway identity primitive, governing the Public (sync/replication) API
note: Identity creation is decoupled from access-granting (creating a user grants no channels by itself). Distinct from sgw:rbac-user, which governs the Admin/Metrics API and is a reuse of the server RBAC model - the docs state explicitly these 'have no relationship' (see relations/has-no-relationship-to.json).
